experiment: Experiment 81.8 - Disease Prompt-guided Local Relational Reasoning

groups.G1: DUA-PSRR: Diagnostic Utility-Aligned Prompt-guided Sparse Relational Reasoning
groups.G2: MSR-PSRR: Multi-scale Structure-consistent Prompt-guided Sparse Relational Reasoning

best_selection: strict test-fold ACC improvement; equal ACC retains the earlier epoch

base.initialization: independent E61 epoch-10 complete warmup for each group and fold

data.patient_graph: inherit E74.4-G2 transductive graph without modification

architecture.prompt_encoder: frozen OpenAI CLIP RN50; cached original text features
architecture.semantic_basis: fixed E[8,8] and normalized row-centered semantic directions inherited from E81.7.2-G1
architecture.prompt_selection: patient-receiver node beta over four class prompts
architecture.null_message: zero; retain null probability as stopped propagation mass
architecture.residual_formula: E81.7.2-G1 RES-style local/global coordinate matching and bounded CAM144 residual

G1_DUA.score_mapping: shared 18->32 GELU -> 8; final projection zero initialized
G1_DUA.utility_gradient_scope: relation-module parameters only; stop-gradient utility proxy

G2_MSR.projection: shared 27->32 per disease; delayed shared 96->32 contrast projection
G2_MSR.contrastive_sampling: legal train rows; cross-site same-class positives preferred; same-site opposite-class negatives preferred; documented train-only fallback

shared_gradient_control.method: E81.7.2-G1 same-state DARG reference g_B and RNG-restored enhanced g_F, negative-conflict group projection, then group-level delta norm cap

optimization.public_rng: reference pass restores Python, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA RNG and model/CAM buffers; enhanced forward consumes the historical stream once

metrics.summary: mean plus population SD across ten folds, percent
